title: Scenario VIII: The Secret of the Black Blade

waves.advisorWarning: Zalpa: Mountain brigands have spotted the smoke of the secret furnace! Form defensive lines around the anvil rock!
Tarkhunta: Protect the leather bellows! If the raiders torch the air chambers, the charcoal heat will die before the slag separates!
Burna-Khabir: Desperate reavers attack from the upper ravines! Hold firm with spear phalanxes and rain arrows into their ranks!
Zalpa: A heavy raiding column with torches approaches from the eastern defile! Extinguish their advance before they breach the smelter terrace!
Tarkhunta: Chieftain Tarkondemos himself descends from the high crags with his vanguard! Strike him down with our newly forged Black Blades!

primary.description: Protect the Heretic Foundry Redoubt at (14, 48).
The Heretic Furnace: Construct the Twin-Bellows Primitive Bloomery on the stone foundation terrace.
Harvest Black Hematite: Mine at least 300 Iron Ore from the surrounding mountain veins.
The Black Blade Vanguard: Train at least 4 Black Blade Iron Warriors at the Twin-Bellows Bloomery.
Repel the Mountain Reavers: Withstand all 5 raiding assault waves.
Slay the Raider Chieftain: Slay Chieftain Tarkondemos.

secondary.description: Clear the Ravines: Destroy the 2 mountain bandit encampments.

narrative.briefing: Year 1165 BC. Deep in the secluded limestone defiles of Cilicia, Tarkhunta uncovers an isolated clan of renegade metalsmiths smelting dark hematite rock using forced-draft twin leather bellows. Defend their glowing crucible from marauders, gather the rich ore, and witness the birth of the first forged iron blade: the weapon that will liberate humanity from the bronze famine.

dialogues.speaker: tarkhunta
dialogues.message: The renegade mountain smiths have revealed the secret of forced-draft smelting! Construct the Twin-Bellows Bloomery on our stone terrace, mine the black hematite, and forge the first Black Blades to shatter the raider phalanxes!

dialogues.speaker: burna_khabir
dialogues.message: The baskets are heavy with black ore, and the first iron blades shine dark and terrible under the forge sparks. The era of aristocratic bronze chariots draws to a close!
